description: This file defines a test implementation of a stream queue balancer for Orleans, which acquires leases once and does not renew them, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: LeaseBasedQueueBalancerForTest
classes.description: A test implementation of a stream queue balancer that acquires leases once and does not renew them, used for testing Orleans stream queue balancing.

methods.name: LeaseBasedQueueBalancerForTest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the balancer with a name and grain factory.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the balancer by setting queues as leases and acquiring initial leases.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Returns the list of queues owned by this balancer.

methods.name: GetInitialLease
methods.description: Private method to acquire initial lease responsibilities.

methods.name: SubscribeToQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to queue distribution change events (no operation, returns true).

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes from queue distribution change events (no operation, returns true).
